description: This file defines inline functions for calculating CRB limits for PDSCH grants based on various configurations and search space parameters, following 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: get_ra_crb_limits
methods.description: Calculates CRB limits for PDSCH grant based on DCI format, BWP configurations, and search space and coreset configurations.

methods.name: get_ra_crb_limits_common
methods.description: Calculates CRB limits for non-UE dedicated allocations like SIB, RAR, SRB0, using initial BWP configuration and search space ID.
